comment: The operator's carefully curated YouTube reference tracks for Dilla's best work, recovered verbatim from pub/index.html at commit a3185f4 (const YOUTUBE_TRACKS). Operator directive 2026-11-22: these are the canon - download them, split them with demucs, and spectrum-analyze each layer's harmonic content and drum patterns. Machine record for the operator's narrowed pick list lives in operator_picks; measured output lands in data/reference_measurements/<slug>.json.

curation_source.commit_subject: restore: index.html demo playlist layout (synced from pub4)

probe_2026_11_22.method: yt-dlp --simulate against each id, morning session

alive_ip_gated.9EGHwkDix78: Microphone Master - alive; YouTube bot-checks this sandbox IP

live_verified.W28aNa8bnRw: Climax (Girl Shit) - live upload found via web search (not on the curation)

measurement_contract: reference_pipeline.py: yt-dlp audio download (operator cookies via DILLA_YT_COOKIES when the sandbox IP is bot-checked) -> demucs htdemucs four-stem split -> reference_stems.py per-stem keys, chroma, spectral bands, drum grids, swing; analyzer_version stems-1; output data/reference_measurements/<slug>.json. lib/reference_analyzer.rb stays the canonical mix-only profile lane for MASTER.

operator_picks.title: Microphone Master (Jay Dee Remix)
operator_picks.released: 1997 single remix; remixer credit J Dilla
operator_picks.curated_source: pub/index.html at a3185f4, const YOUTUBE_TRACKS n=1
operator_picks.identity_note: The curation attributes it to 'J Dilla'; WhoSampled's page is 'Das EFX's Microphone Master (Remix) remix by J Dilla' (remix/81107). Radio Bergen metadata keeps the artist label 'J Dilla' for the player; the release identity is the Das EFX remix credit.

samples_documented.claim: remix by J Dilla; samples Clare Fischer 'You Call It Madness', Art of Noise 'Opus 4', A Tribe Called Quest 'Lyrics to Go'

operator_picks.title: Untitled / Fantastic
operator_picks.curated_source: pub/index.html at a3185f4, const YOUTUBE_TRACKS n=11
operator_picks.identity_note: Radio Bergen lists the title as 'Fantastic'; the FV2 pressing names the track 'Untitled / Fantastic'. Fills the fourth pick slot in place of the nonexistent 'Life' (see picks_note).

samples_documented.claim: samples Herbie Hancock 'You'll Know When You Get There' (1971); matches the fantastic_herbie_flip citation in recovered_music.json

operator_picks_note: Operator named four example tracks. 'life' does not exist as a Slum Village or J Dilla track on Fan-Tas-Tic Vol. 1 or Fantastic, Vol. 2 (both tracklists checked); closest real title is 'My Life' feat. Frank N Dank (2005, post-Dilla). The fourth slot uses the operator's own curated 'Fantastic'. If 'My Life' was intended it can be added as a fifth pick.
pipeline: yt-dlp download (operator cookies) -> demucs htdemucs four-stem split -> STUDIO/dilla/reference_stems.py per-layer spectral/harmonic measurement (operator-directed deep lane) -> data/reference_measurements/<slug>.json; lib/reference_analyzer.rb stays the canonical mix-only profile lane for MASTER
